## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual abridgement (略 = "abridged") by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) — the practitioner's-handbook companion to the longer Mārīcī materials [KR6j0483](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0483) (T1254) and [KR6j0484](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0484)–[KR6j0485](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0485) (T1255a/b). The text supplies a compressed daily-practice format suitable for the practitioner who cannot perform the full elaborated rite.

**Abstract**

The text gives the abbreviated Mārīcī-recitation programme: brief opening invocation, mantra-recitation, the essential mudrās, the *bīja* visualisation, and the dismissal — in a form that can be performed in a brief sitting. The dating bracket follows Amoghavajra's Chángān activity (746–774).
